sub_graphs.title: Light Client: Sync Protocol State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions a light client undergoes during synchronization across protocol upgrades (Altair through Electra)

nodes.label: Light Client Uninitialized
nodes.description: Light client has no trusted state and needs a bootstrap to begin syncing

nodes.label: Bootstrap Light Client from Checkpoint
nodes.description: Initialize light client store from a trusted checkpoint (finalized block root) by fetching a LightClientBootstrap object

nodes.label: Light Client Bootstrapped
nodes.description: Light client has a trusted header and current sync committee; ready to process updates

nodes.label: Process Light Client Update
nodes.description: Validate and apply a LightClientUpdate to advance the light client's trusted state, potentially updating finalized header and sync committee

nodes.label: Light Client Synced to Finalized Head
nodes.description: Light client's finalized header is up to date with the network's finalized checkpoint

nodes.label: Process Optimistic Update
nodes.description: Apply a LightClientOptimisticUpdate to track the latest head without waiting for finality

nodes.label: Light Client Tracking Optimistic Head
nodes.description: Light client is tracking the latest attested head optimistically

edges.label: Store initialized with finalized header and sync committee
Process subsequent updates for new periods

external_entities.name: Full Node / Light Client Server
external_entities.description: Full beacon node serving LightClientBootstrap, LightClientUpdate, and LightClientOptimisticUpdate objects to light clients

external_entities.name: Trusted Checkpoint Provider
external_entities.description: Source of the trusted finalized block root used to bootstrap the light client (e.g., weak subjectivity checkpoint)

sub_graphs.title: Light Client: P2P Communication Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the P2P networking layer for light client data distribution across protocol upgrades

nodes.label: Light Client Connected to Peers
nodes.description: Light client has established P2P connections to full nodes serving light client data

nodes.label: Request LightClientBootstrap
nodes.description: Send req/resp request to a peer for a LightClientBootstrap object corresponding to a finalized block root

nodes.label: Request LightClientUpdates by Range
nodes.description: Send req/resp request for a range of LightClientUpdate objects covering specific sync committee periods

nodes.label: Subscribe to Light Client Gossip Topics
nodes.description: Subscribe to gossipsub topics for LightClientFinalityUpdate and LightClientOptimisticUpdate

nodes.label: Receiving Light Client Updates
nodes.description: Light client is actively receiving updates via gossip and/or req/resp

external_entities.name: Peer Full Nodes
external_entities.description: Full beacon nodes that serve light client protocol data via req/resp and gossip

sub_graphs.title: Light Client: Fork Upgrade Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models how light client data structures and protocols transition across Ethereum consensus forks (Altair, Capella, Deneb, Electra)

nodes.label: Light Client at Pre-Fork Version
nodes.description: Light client is operating with data structures from a previous fork version

nodes.label: Detect Fork Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: Detect that the current slot/epoch has crossed a fork boundary requiring light client data format upgrade

nodes.label: Upgrade Light Client Store
nodes.description: Transform light client store data structures from previous fork format to new fork format (e.g., Capella LightClientStore to Deneb LightClientStore)

nodes.label: Light Client at Post-Fork Version
nodes.description: Light client is operating with upgraded data structures for the new fork

edges.label: Store upgraded to new fork version

ambiguities.text: The index page does not specify which specific data fields change between fork versions for light client structures.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume each fork's dedicated spec document (e.g., deneb/light-client/fork) defines the exact field additions and transformations. Cross-reference individual fork specs.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between 'Full Node' specs and 'Light Client' specs in terms of data serving responsibilities is implicit from the navigation structure.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'Full Node' specs define how full nodes prepare and serve light client data, while 'Sync Protocol' specs define how light clients consume it.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients trust that at least 2/3 of the sync committee members are honest, as sync committee signatures are the sole source of truth for light client updates.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A corrupted sync committee supermajority could sign invalid headers, causing light clients to follow an invalid chain.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients assume reliable network connectivity to at least one honest full node serving light client data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An isolated light client could be eclipsed and fed only attacker-controlled updates, enabling long-range attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The initial bootstrap checkpoint is assumed to come from a trusted source (weak subjectivity assumption).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Bootstrapping from a malicious checkpoint could place the light client on an invalid fork from the start.
